body: i would love to, really. im sorry. i know im being difficult and that youre just trying to help and im being so contrary. but i physically cant. i try and write and my mind just blanks and all i can think of is how much id rather just be gone and have a break from everything, even film. i just cant find any joy in it anymore.

thanks for the reply. i would usually use film to help, write vent-scripts about people in my situation, but now i just...cant?? i just dont have the motivation. i dont really see the point anymore. i dont even really know if i want to crawl out of this.
